kai: Heads up — after the kernel+driver roll on the us-west-gpu pool a few hours ago, ~10% of multi-GPU training jobs started hitting NCCL P2P errors. Posting a representative log paste:

kai: ```
[2026-10-18 09:12:34] NCCL WARN Topology detection failed on rank 1: All gpus not reachable via P2P
[2026-10-18 09:12:34] NCCL INFO Selected network transport: NET/Socket (fallback)
[2026-10-18 09:12:34] NCCL ERROR ncclCommConnectAll failed : Unreachable
```

meera: Which nodes are impacted? Canary only or whole pool?

kai: Mostly mixed-gen hosts: gpu-usw2-a-012, gpu-usw2-b-021, gpu-usw2-c-003 — some Hopper (H100) + A100 racks. Canary was included in the rollout.

david: Did we change driver version or kernel ABI? Need exact outputs from affected hosts: `nvidia-smi`, `nvidia-smi topo -m`, `uname -r` and `lsmod | grep nvidia`.

kai: Pasted quick snaps from gpu-usw2-a-012:

kai: ```
$ uname -r
5.19.0-40-generic
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,cuda_version --format=csv
driver_version: 535.86.10, cuda_version: 12.2
$ nvidia-smi topo -m
        GPU0    GPU1    CPU Affinity
GPU0    X      NV1     0-23
GPU1    NV1    X       0-23

# on a different host (gpu-usw2-b-021)
$ nvidia-smi topo -m
        GPU0    GPU1
GPU0    X      PCIe
GPU1    PCIe   X
```

meera: So some hosts still show NVLink (NV1) and others PCIe only. If topology table is inconsistent across hosts in a job, NCCL may choose an incorrect path or think p2p isn't available.

ops-oncall: deploy-bot: driver-rollout completed @ 2026-10-18T08:45:00Z for pool=us-west-gpu. Tags: driver=535.86.10, kernel=5.19.0-40.

linh: Can we temporarily force network transport to avoid OOM/failure while we investigate? Set `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0` and `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` for affected jobs — will fall back to sockets but keep jobs alive. Not ideal but buys time.

greg: Agree. Also can we cordon the truly mixed nodes from multi-GPU scheduling until fixed? Move single-GPU jobs to them if possible.

meera: Quick checklist: 1) confirm driver module version on all hosts 2) check for stale DKMS modules after kernel bump 3) ensure `nvidia-persistenced` running 4) check PCI device ordering changes (NVLink pairs can change ordinal)

kai: I checked kernel module versions — some hosts show `nvidia 535.86.10` in `lsmod`, others show `nvidia 535.86.9` (leftover). Seems DKMS build/rmmod sequence got interrupted on a subset during the rolling kernel restart.

david: That would explain the mismatch. If kernel module and userland driver mismatch you can get broken topology detection because `nvidia-smi topo -m` relies on the kernel-level NVLink info.

linh: Proposed immediate remediation plan:
- cordon affected nodes (gpu-usw2-b-021, gpu-usw2-c-003) from multi-GPU scheduling
- run `sudo dkms autoinstall` + reboot or `sudo modprobe -r nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm nvidia; sudo modprobe nvidia` where safe
- restart `nvidia-persistenced` and container runtime on each host
- run `nvidia-smi topo -m` and compare to baseline

ops-oncall: I'm taking lead on cordoning + autoscaler adjustments. Putting a support page note for customers on long-running jobs. :iphone:

kai: Quick test on a patched host (gpu-usw2-a-012) after rebuilding DKMS: `nvidia-smi topo -m` now shows consistent NVLink across GPUs. Re-ran failing job — no NCCL p2p errors, performance matches pre-roll.

meera: Good. Longer term: we should add a pre-roll validation to the driver rollout job that runs on each host: check `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv` and `nvidia-smi topo -m` sanity, and fail the host update if mismatch. Also add alert on `NCCL WARN.*P2P` pattern in logging.

greg: Can ops create a canary pool that excludes mixed-gen hosts for future upgrades? Also add a CI job that runs small NCCL allreduce across mixed nodes to catch ordering issues.

kai: Action items captured:
- ops-oncall: cordon affected nodes + shift workloads (in progress)
- infra: add DKMS autoinstall step to rollout job + preflight topo check (meera/david)
- devex: document `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` fallback and perf implications (linh)
- oncall: add log alert for NCCL P2P fallbacks and NET/Socket selection (greg)

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2137 "Driver rollout preflight: topo + dkms validation" assigned to meera.

meera: Will follow up with a small PR to the rollout pipeline and a playbook for manual remediation (modprobe/dkms steps).

kai: Thanks everyone. Will keep this thread updated when all nodes are clean. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: update: cordoned gpu-usw2-b-021, gpu-usw2-c-003; set `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` on queued multi-gpu jobs as we drain. ETA 45m for rebuild+reboot window.

kai: Confirming last failing job cleared after node fix at 2026-10-18T10:04:50Z. Closing loop once preflight merged.
